questions: Should the x-axis tick labels be the string representation of the grouping columns (e.g., '1-1') as in the reference solution, or should they be something else like the index of the group?
Is the order of groups in the analyzed DataFrame (and thus the line chart) important? If so, how should groups be sorted?
Should the line chart connect points in the order they appear in the analyzed DataFrame, or should it be sorted by some criterion (e.g., x-axis values)?
What should happen if there are no rows in the input data? Should the function return an empty DataFrame and an empty plot, or raise an error?
Are the grouping columns expected to be numeric, string, or mixed types? How should non-string types be handled when creating the x-label string?
Should the plot include any specific markers, line styles, or titles beyond the x-label and y-label?
Is the function required to handle cases where the last column contains non-hashable or NaN values when counting unique values?
Should the function close or show the plot, or is returning the Axes object sufficient without modifying the global plot state?
